'''Quality Map''' is a {{Special}} item given to build team members who helped design the [[Locations|SkyBlock islands]]. 

== Obtaining ==
'''Quality Map''' was awarded to members of the Build Team who helped design the SkyBlock public islands. The 
'''Quality Map''' was awarded by {{RN|a}}s.
== Trivia ==
* The only 3 known versions of the item are owned by {{RN|ssm=true|mvp+|Dueces}}, {{RN|ssm=true|a|Cheesey}} and {{RN|ssm=true|a|AdamWho}}.
* For April Fools, the description of this item was used on [[Move Jerry]]s.
